items.comments: Ted was great at communicating with me even throughout my stay. The home is very clean and close to everything.  Loved the modern look, would definitely recommend!

I had a wonderful experience in Ted's home. The house was beautiful, loved the interior and how modern everything was. Ted himself was an awesome host. He helped accommodate to certain circumstances and made sure we had everything we needed! I would definitely recommend staying in this beautiful home if you have the chance.
